name: Android Application Security Testing
description: Security assessment of Android applications. Covers APK analysis, manifest review, component security (activities, services, broadcast receivers, content providers), data storage review, certificate pinning bypass, root detection bypass, and runtime manipulation with Frida.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to Android security testing

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands Android application architecture and security model
evidence: Can explain the Android component model (activities, services, providers, receivers)
Understands Android permission model and IPC mechanisms
Familiar with OWASP Mobile Top 10

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic Android app analysis under supervision
evidence: Decompiled APKs using jadx or apktool and reviewed manifest
Tested data storage (SharedPreferences, SQLite, files) for sensitive data leaks
Set up and used an Android testing environment (emulator or rooted device)
Work reviewed by authorized tester

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently tests Android apps against OWASP MASTG methodology
evidence: Independently tested 5+ Android applications
Bypasses certificate pinning using Frida or Objection
Tests exported components for unauthorized access and injection
Evaluates cryptographic storage and transport security independently
Passed proficiency assessment on Android security testing

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Tests complex Android apps; bypasses advanced protections; writes Frida scripts
evidence: Bypasses root detection and integrity checking mechanisms
Writes custom Frida scripts for runtime hooking and manipulation
Tests NDK/native code components for vulnerabilities
Mentors junior testers on Android testing methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on Android security; discovers platform-level vulnerabilities
evidence: Published research or CVEs related to Android application or platform security
Developed the lab's Android testing methodology and tooling
Reverse engineers obfuscated and packed applications
Trains teams on advanced Android exploitation techniques

assessment_methods.description: Complete a security assessment of a prepared Android application covering OWASP MASTG test cases
Observe setup of test environment and dynamic analysis workflow
